name: P_TOD
wanted: in a TOD zone, not in HDC, land pooling or zone O
how_it_was_found: Rajiv Chowk if it qualifies, otherwise the largest TOD polygon

name: P_HDC
wanted: in the High Density Corridor, and in nothing else if possible
how_it_was_found: a point inside the single HDC polygon; the HDC follows UER-II through the land pooling areas and crosses TOD corridors, so a point in HDC alone is preferred to keep the location comparison readable

name: P_ZONEO
wanted: in planning zone O, on land rather than in the river
how_it_was_found: a point in the zone O polygon that the Yamuna river layer does not cover

name: P_LP
how_it_was_found: a point inside the largest land pooling polygon

name: P_RIDGE
wanted: in a Regional Park (the Ridge), and in nothing else if possible
how_it_was_found: a point inside the largest regional park polygon; the Ridge is asked for on its own because the ridge topic has no policy section of its own and works only through boosting and query expansion (D-069)

name: P_LDA
wanted: in a Low Density Area, and in nothing else if possible
how_it_was_found: a point inside the largest low density area polygon; the LDAs sit along the NCT border, where the land pooling areas also are, so a point in the LDA alone is preferred to keep the comparison readable

name: P_PLAIN
wanted: in Delhi but in none of the six policy zones
how_it_was_found: found by walking a 60x60 grid over Delhi from the middle out

name: P_OUT
how_it_was_found: a point in Gurugram, given in the brief
